source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of economic disparities (PDF 183).

blocks.text: Bohat si naukriyon ke liye kam az kam bunyadi digital maharat chahiye, to baghair technology ya internet ke logon ko kaam milna mushkil hota aur pasmanda biradariyon mein berozgari barhti hai. Pakistan mein online job portals aur digital banking aksar shehri ilaqon tak mehdood hain, jis se shehri aur dehi maeeshat ka faasla barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek tareeqa bataiye jis se digital divide maeeshati faasle barhata hai.
blocks.explanation: Baghair internet ke log online job portals se apply ya digital banking istemal nahi kar sakte, to naukriyon aur maali khidmat se mehroom rehte hain.

items: Maeeshati farq: digital rasai na ho to kam naukriyan aur maali khidmat.
